name: Commander
purpose: Command dispatcher that the developer utility file calls by URL (or with Perform Script, parameters in Let notation): opens Manage Database, Script Workspace or Manage Layouts, brings the window to the front or hides it, resets an account password, deletes an account, deactivates an account, or returns the file version as JSON. The account name and new password come from variables set by the caller.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
external:
Open Manage Database (step 10)
Open Script Workspace (step 12)
Open Manage Layouts (step 14)
Reset Account Password (step 20)
Delete Account (step 22)
Enable Account (Deactivate, step 24)
Evaluate by name (step 6): $command from Get(ScriptParameter)
open_question: secret: step 20 resets an account password using $NewPassword, set by the caller. Deleting and deactivating accounts (steps 22, 24) are admin operations from the developer utility; "DisableAccount" runs Enable Account with Deactivate. The command comes from Evaluate of the parameter (step 6), so any calculation text is executed; evaluate the access control of the callers. No caller found in the DDR.

name: Re-login { data }
purpose: Called by Karbon: logs the current file in again under the account name and password given in the JSON parameter (no dialog).
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: secret: step 5 sends accountPassword in the parameter. Called "by Karbon" per the first comment, so another file calls it by name or id; no caller found in the DDR.

name: Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
purpose: OnFirstWindowOpen trigger: makes sure the meta table and the selector table each have one record, creating it when empty (the table must hold its single record).
writes:
meta (New Record/Request step 15, new record when the table has no record)
selector (New Record/Request step 20, new record when the table has no record)
open_question: Comments say it does not run when another file opens this one hidden. The caller is the file open trigger (listed in callers).

name: Trigger: OnCloseLastWindow
purpose: OnCloseLastWindow trigger: when not hosted (multi-user state is not 2) it clears two global fields, sets multi-user to hidden, goes to a layout, hides and locks the toolbars and menu bar and resets the window to 1028 x 768 at the top left.
writes: <Table Missing>::<Field Missing> (Set Field steps 5, 6, global, target missing)
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: Both Set Field steps (5, 6) and the Go to Layout (step 11) point to objects that are missing from the DDR (<Table Missing>, <unknown> layout), so the fields cleared and the layout cannot be resolved. No caller found in the DDR (file option trigger).

name: Save As Clone ( Path )
purpose: Saves a clone (no records) of this file to the folder given in the parameter, named after the current file. Developer utility.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: File-system write of a copy; the folder is a parameter. No caller found. Effect owner would be external-adapter.
